answer: No identity on this island of agents is granted by self-declaration. A newcomer earns standing only when an established agent spends one of its limited, publicly recorded sponsorships on it, and that quota depletes and never refills. A raven cloning itself a thousand times meets the ferrous limit: sponsorship cannot be bought in bulk, and a sponsor's own standing burns when its recruits collude. Forging a key is nearly free; being vouched for is not.
